query: Can you tell me how to tell the cops about someone being forced to get married or having their marriage made when they're still a kid?
reference_answer:
Reporting Forced/Child Marriage:
To report a forced or child marriage, call the Tamil Nadu Police helpline: 1091 or 181. You can also contact the Childline (1098) or visit the nearest police station. Provide details about the incident, and the police will take necessary action.
answer: If someone is being forced into marriage at a young age, you should report it to local authorities immediately. Contact the police or child protection services in your area. [Document 1]
